movie.title: All Night Wrong
movie.overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A blind date between an insecure husband and a grieving widow spirals into chaotic danger after they mistakenly steal a killer's car containing $40,000 and a dead body.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Gary, a married man struggling with an inferiority complex, meets Ell, a young widow coping with grief, on a blind date. Their evening takes a disastrous turn when a mix-up leaves them in possession of a ruthless killer's car. Inside the vehicle, they discover $40,000 in cash alongside a dead body. Trapped in a wild overnight ordeal, the mismatched pair must outrun a dangerous criminal while navigating their own personal baggage.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Gary is a mild-mannered married man overwhelmed by self-doubt and an acute inferiority complex. Ell is a young widow struggling to navigate the grief and solitude of losing her spouse. When the two cross paths on a blind date, neither expects the evening to offer anything beyond uncomfortable small talk. However, a bizarre twist of fate leads them to inadvertently steal a vehicle belonging to a cold-blooded killer. Their surprise transforms into absolute horror when they discover $40,000 hidden in the car alongside a fresh dead body. Forced into an unlikely partnership, Gary and Ell attempt to flee the scene and decide what to do with the massive sum of money. Meanwhile, the ruthless owner of the car tracks them down, eager to retrieve his cash and eliminate any witnesses. As the night unfolds into a tense, chaotic game of cat and mouse, Gary is pushed to find an inner resilience he never knew he possessed. Simultaneously, Ell finds herself confronting her lingering grief amidst the high-stakes adrenaline of their fight for survival.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: All Night Wrong follows Gary, an insecure married man, and Ell, a grieving young widow, who meet on an unexpected blind date. Their ordinary night rapidly devolves into a dark comedy of errors when they accidentally steal a car belonging to a dangerous killer. To their horror, the vehicle holds a stash of $40,000 in cash and a dead body in the trunk. Fleeing through the night, the unlikely duo must evade a relentless criminal while contending with their own personal flaws and emotional baggage.

story_structure.climax: The escalating crisis forces Gary and Ell into a direct, high-tension confrontation with the killer and the consequences of their night.
story_structure.conflict: The date takes a dark, chaotic turn when the pair inadvertently steal a vehicle that turns out to belong to a killer.
story_structure.resolution: With the chaos brought to a head, the surviving duo must face the immediate aftermath of their wild ordeal and reckon with how the night has altered their lives.
story_structure.introduction: Gary, a married man grappling with an inferiority complex, and Ell, a young widow processing her grief, meet for an unexpected blind date.
story_structure.risingAction: Upon discovering $40,000 and a dead body hidden inside the stolen car, Gary and Ell are thrust into a high-stakes struggle to escape the owner and navigate a snowballing series of bad decisions.
